description: Reads historical odds for one sport: the raw board as it stood at a time you name (kind snapshot), or a UTC day's opening and closing prices (kind closing). Serves every region, one region code a call: the UK & Ireland (uk) from 17 October 2026, with exchange prices beside the bookmakers'; each other region from 16 November 2026, bookmakers only. A date outside the archive is refused with date_out_of_range and the earliest or latest date it holds. A day is added the night after it ends, so read today's prices with raw_odds. Spends tokens: priced first, and refused when it would cost more than max_tokens. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor within five minutes; each page is priced.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous reply, with the same other arguments

date.description: snapshot: a time, ISO 8601, such as 2026-11-16T12:00:00Z. closing: a UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD

kind.description: snapshot: the board at one time. closing: one day's opening and closing prices

limit.description: Most events to return; a note counts the rest

markets.description: Only these market keys, such as h2h

max_tokens.description: Refuse the call when its quoted price is above this many tokens. Ask the user before raising it.

region.description: One region code from the regions tool, such as uk or us. Left out, the API uses uk, or refuses with region_required and names the code to send.

sport.description: Which sport: a sport key or the start of one, such as soccer

name: history
title: Historical odds
